title: Debug runtime or API set
description:
Two small checks for a list of DLL names from `dumpbin /dependents`:

- `bool needsDebugRuntime(const std::vector<std::string>& dlls)`: true if any of them is a debug build of the Visual C++ runtime: `msvcp140d.dll`, `vcruntime140d.dll`, `vcruntime140_1d.dll` or `ucrtbased.dll` (any upper/lower case).
- `bool isApiSet(const std::string& dll)`: true if the name is an API set, which starts with `api-ms-` or `ext-ms-` (any case). Windows redirects those to real DLLs, so a tool should not report them as missing.
lessonTitle: Inspecting DLLs with dumpbin and Dependencies
